# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.mjs` is compiled from Project Nayuki's TypeScript QR encoder (MIT license retained in the file).
Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/master/typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts
Pinned source blob: c4191ac0b5f8a24d87fd9340ceaa2d3b07d0231a
Compiled with the project's TypeScript compiler targeting ES2020 modules, with comments retained. No remote script or QR service is loaded at runtime.
